2. Apply Offer 1 (half off cheaper): $40 / 2 = $20.
3. Calculate subtotal: $20 (discounted pair) + $60 (full price pair) = $80.
4. Apply Offer 2 (1/4 off total): $80 / 4 = $20 discount.
